basis: The queue's starting corpus is kept unless another corpus that carries the same stroke count follows the dictionary's per-stroke directions more closely, as established in the grade 1 batch 24 re-review and used in the earlier special grade batches. Only differences that change the flagged-stroke count are acted on; a few degrees is noise.

冉.reason: Ja writes the inner bar of 冉 after the vertical (two strokes over 60°, max 100°); MM follows the dictionary with no stroke over 8°.

嬴.reason: Ja writes the 月 and 女 parts of the 羸 body in a different order (three strokes over 60°, max 131°); the simplified file leaves one stroke at 63°, the opening dot of 亠.

贏.reason: Ja reorders the 貝 and 凡 parts under 亡口 (five strokes over 60°, max 157°); the traditional file is worse still (six), while the simplified file follows the dictionary with no stroke over 59°.

雝.reason: Ja writes the bars of 隹 in a different order (three strokes over 60°, max 100°); MM leaves one, the top-right tick, which was then corrected.
